questions.question: Who among the following was the first martyr of the Telangana Armed Struggle (1946-1951), killed on July 4, 1946, in Kadavendi village?
questions.explanation: Doddi Komaraiah was martyred on July 4, 1946, at Kadavendi village in Warangal district, marking the spark of the armed peasant struggle against feudal oppression.

questions.question: The historic Gentlemen's Agreement between Andhra and Telangana leaders was signed on which date in New Delhi?
questions.explanation: The Gentlemen's Agreement was signed on February 20, 1956, in New Delhi to provide statutory safeguards for Telangana prior to the merger forming Andhra Pradesh.

questions.question: Which political organization was led by Dr. M. Chenna Reddy to spearhead the 1969 Jai Telangana Movement?
questions.explanation: Telangana Praja Samithi (TPS) was led by Dr. M. Chenna Reddy during the 1969 agitation to demand statehood following violations of Mulki rules.

questions.question: The Five-Member Committee for Consultations on the Situation in Andhra Pradesh constituted in 2010 was headed by which retired Supreme Court judge?
questions.explanation: The committee was chaired by former Supreme Court Judge Justice B.N. Srikrishna and submitted its detailed report on December 30, 2010.

questions.question: As per the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, which date was officially declared as the Appointed Day for the formal formation of Telangana State?
questions.explanation: June 2, 2014, was notified as the Appointed Day when Telangana officially emerged as the 29th state of India.
